heroDescription: Rooted in Ocala, our fleets and project crews cover eight counties, delivering generational masonry, custom carpentry, and architectural finishes right to your property.

countiesSectionDesc: Click a county below to understand local guidelines, regional project hubs, and specialized building crews available for your address.
authorityDesc: Building in central Florida demands hyper-local fluency. Here is how Ferrentino & Son delivers uncompromised reliability from city blocks to shoreline communities.

regionalFeatures.title: Permitting Familiarity
regionalFeatures.desc: Each municipal boundary holds specific ordinances. We maintain long-standing operational relationships with building departments across all 8 active counties, ensuring rapid permit approvals with zero unexpected compliance friction.

regionalFeatures.desc: From beach-facing Volusia lots to high-water Lake County docks, we build with strict structural defenses, implementing specialized storm strapping, storm-rated impact glazings, and advanced moisture-barrier applications.

On-budget execution and locally verified materials guarantee.
Counties actively supported with dedicated craftsman networks.

specialtyServicesDesc: From custom-designed luxury kitchen transformations to complex structural additions, we craft spaces built around your routine and designed to last generations.

specialtyServices.title: Kitchen Remodeling
specialtyServices.description: Create a kitchen that combines functionality, comfort, and style. We remodel it to make cooking, gathering, storing, and everyday life feel easier, while giving the space a look that feels completely at home.

specialtyServices.title: Bathroom Remodeling
specialtyServices.description: Small room, big impact. We rework bathrooms with better layouts, smarter storage, updated finishes, and details that make the space feel noticeably better every day.

specialtyServices.title: Home Remodeling
specialtyServices.description: Sometimes a home just needs to work differently. We rethink outdated spaces, awkward layouts, and tired finishes to create a home that fits the way you live now.

specialtyServices.title: Home Renovations
specialtyServices.description: Keep the character. Change what's not working. Our renovation work brings older or dated spaces forward while respecting the home that was already there.

specialtyServices.title: Home Additions
specialtyServices.description: Need more room? Expand your living space with a thoughtfully designed addition that complements your existing home.

specialtyServices.title: Interior Remodeling
specialtyServices.description: A few walls, finishes, or layout changes can completely shift how a home feels. We help remodel interiors so each space feels intentional.

specialtyServices.title: Design & Planning
specialtyServices.description: Turn your ideas into a practical project plan. We help guide layout, functionality, materials, finishes, and design decisions before construction begins.

specialtyServices.title: Custom Carpentry
specialtyServices.description: Add character and detail to your home with custom carpentry, trim work, built-ins, woodwork, doors, and finishing details.

specialtyServices.title: Exterior Renovations
specialtyServices.description: We update exterior details, finishes, and features to give the home a stronger, more finished presence from the street.

blueprintDesc: Building your custom home or managing a complex remodel should be as rewarding as it is exciting. Here is how we ensure pristine transparency from concept to completion.

blueprintSteps.title: Initial Consultation
blueprintSteps.desc: We sit down with you to map your vision, explore functional design flaws, evaluate necessary code requirements, and align with your target budget.

blueprintSteps.title: 3D Design & Plan
blueprintSteps.desc: We bring custom architectural plans to life and provide 3D digital simulation so you can examine every inch of your space before breaking ground.

blueprintSteps.title: Turnkey Management
blueprintSteps.desc: Protection barriers, active county communication, schedule synchronization, and oversight overseen by our senior lead master.

blueprintSteps.title: Pristine Handover
blueprintSteps.desc: After detailed inspection, structural reviews, and custom paint touching, we hand over your beautiful new space ready for generations to use.

faqs.answer: Foundation engineering is our absolute specialty. Before we break ground on any custom build or master wing expansion, we perform comprehensive soil-bearing capacity assessments and engineer reinforced steel-concrete structures designed against shifts.

faqs.question: What is the average timeline for a luxury kitchen remodel?
faqs.answer: Depending on design complexity and structural wall changes, most custom Marion County kitchen remodels are completed within 4 to 8 weeks. We provide a full weekly scheduling blueprint before construction starts.

faqs.question: Are your estimators and trade partners fully certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, Ferrentino & Son is fully licensed, insured, and bonded. We only partner with verified local trade, mechanical professionals, and concrete suppliers who share our standards for safety and structural excellence.
